description: Which options of a choice question respondents are offered (choices[].logic and properties.optionFilter), and what follows from it. 'form' is the list of pages as the respondent page receives it; 'answers' are the answers as handed to validation; 'locked' lists questions a field rule sets or locks (not filtered). Every case has 'hidden' (question id -> the option ids that are not available; questions with none left out) and 'noneLeft' (questions with no available option and no "Other"), checked on both sides, and optionally 'warnings' ({fieldId, code, optionId?}, any order). Checks 'validate' add 'errors' (every problem of server answer validation, any order; run by backend tests/app/services/test_option_logic_cases.py), checks 'clear' add 'answersAfter' (what the respondent page leaves after clearing selections of options that are not available; null: no answer; run by webapp src/utils/option-logic.cases.test.ts). Backend src: services/option_logic.py; webapp twin: src/utils/option-logic.ts.
